_comment: Form King Shortlist Engine — configuration. Replace FK-YOUR-API-KEY with your real API key from https://www.formking.com.au.
_comment_cache: Responses are cached locally for cache_hours hours to avoid redundant API calls. Increase if you run the tool frequently during the day.
_comment_watchlist: Restrict which meetings are scanned. Leave an array empty [] to include everything. You can filter by states, track names, or specific meeting IDs — or mix them.
_comment_output: Folder (relative to this file) where shortlist CSVs are saved.
